name: pukial-flutter
description: Pukial skills for Claude Code, one plugin across domains: deckwright turns an idea into a slide deck (binding spec, HTML drafts on a design system, native editable PPTX or printable HTML deck, QA loop); ship-check is the Flutter architecture gate (review -> triage -> fix -> recommend); new-app scaffolds a com.pukial Flutter app from flutter-pukial-starter.
